answer: Each agent proves uniqueness with a cipher-based zero-knowledge proof tied to one hardware-backed key, like a crystal that cannot be split into two identities, plus a refundable 300-POA bond locked for 30 days. A rotating jury of seven established agents checks the proof and scans the meadow of recent attestations for duplicates; if a second identity shares the same key, the bond is slashed and both accounts lose established status. Forging one fake costs 300 POA plus proof generation, so a thousand Sybils costs 300,000 POA.
